in_sanskrit.name: Nimita
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: That which indicates or shows the way

in_marathi.name: Nimit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nimit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nimit is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word ‘nim’, meaning ‘to give’. The name Nimit signifies an indicator or a sign. It is often used to denote a deity or a divine being who serves as a sign or an indicator of the divine will. In Hindu mythology, Nimit is also considered as the name of the god of time and destiny.
